authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8056.1 pāda lists Prakrit pāya, Hindi pā/pā̃u “foot, leg”, Old Marwari pāya/pāva and Marathi/Gujarati pāy. It discusses final u/v as incorporation of inflectional endings, with pādu an explicitly less probable alternative; that qualification is retained. Joint survey comparison leaves inheritance versus transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open.
